name: 🫔 Cheesy Beef Enchiladas
tagline: Saucy, cheesy beef and bean enchiladas, baked in one pan and topped with cool sour cream.

steps.text: Brown the beef with the onion in a skillet until cooked through; drain the fat.
Stir in cumin, chili powder, salt, the beans and ½ cup enchilada sauce.
Spread ½ cup sauce in a 9×13 dish.
Fill each tortilla with beef and a sprinkle of cheese, roll, and lay seam side down.
Pour the rest of the sauce over, covering the ends so they don't dry out. Top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake until bubbling, covered for 15 minutes then uncovered 10.
Top with sour cream, cilantro and avocado.

kid_jobs.job: Pick cilantro leaves and cut lime wedges

chef_tip: Sauce the tortilla ends too. Any dry edge goes crunchy and hard; covered ends stay soft and saucy.
make_ahead: Assemble the night before; add 10 minutes to the bake straight from the fridge.
leftovers: Microwave a portion covered with a damp towel. Great with a fried egg on top for breakfast.
swaps: Mission soft taco tortillas for smaller ones
serve_with: Tortilla chips and salsa, Alexia street corn
